tagline.en: Build next week's outbound plan in twenty minutes instead of two days.
tagline.zh: 把下周的发运计划从两天压缩到二十分钟。

problem.en: Outbound plans were assembled by hand in spreadsheets from three different systems. Every customer change meant re-keying the whole sheet, versions circulated by email, and the plan was usually stale before the warehouse read it.
problem.zh: 发运计划此前需从三个系统手工汇总到表格中。客户每有变动就要重新录入整张表，版本通过邮件流转，仓库拿到时计划往往已经过期。

solution.en: A single planning workspace that pulls orders, stock and carrier capacity, proposes a load plan against the planner's constraints, and publishes one version that the warehouse and the carriers both read.
solution.zh: 统一的计划工作台：自动汇总订单、库存与承运商运力，按计划员设定的约束生成装载方案，并发布唯一版本供仓库与承运商共同查阅。

en: Orders, stock and open capacity sync from ERP and WMS every night.
The planner sets the week's constraints — dock hours, carrier capacity, priority customers.
The engine proposes a load plan and flags orders it cannot fit.
The planner adjusts by hand where judgement is needed, then publishes.
Warehouse, transport and carriers all read the same published version.
zh: 每晚从 ERP 与 WMS 同步订单、库存与可用运力。
计划员设定本周约束——月台工作时间、承运商运力、优先客户。
系统生成装载方案，并标出无法排入的订单。
计划员对需人工判断的部分进行调整后发布。
仓库、运输与承运商查阅同一个已发布版本。

en: screenshot — weekly plan grid with capacity warnings
screenshot — published plan as the warehouse sees it
zh: 截图 — 周计划表与运力预警
截图 — 仓库端查看的已发布计划

en: Can I still override the proposed plan? || Yes. The engine proposes, the planner decides. Every manual change is kept in the version history with the name of whoever made it.
Does it replace the weekly planning meeting? || No. It removes the first forty minutes of that meeting, which used to be spent agreeing on which spreadsheet was current.
zh: 我还能手动调整系统建议的计划吗？ || 可以。系统只负责建议，决策权在计划员。每次手工修改都会连同操作人记录在版本历史中。
它会取代每周计划会议吗？ || 不会。它省去了会议开头约四十分钟——过去这段时间都用在确认哪份表格是最新版本。

tagline.en: A desk robot that files the repetitive logistics paperwork nobody should be doing by hand.
tagline.zh: 替你完成重复性物流单据工作的桌面机器人。

problem.en: Teams spent two to three hours a day copying the same data between the ERP, customer portals and email. High volume, no judgement required, and a steady rate of transcription errors that only surfaced downstream.
problem.zh: 各团队每天花两到三小时在 ERP、客户门户与邮件之间重复搬运同样的数据。工作量大、无需判断，而录入差错持续发生且往往到下游才被发现。

solution.en: A library of attended and unattended bots that log in, read, key and confirm. Each bot is owned by the team whose work it does, not by IT — they nominate the task and sign off the result.
solution.zh: 一套有人值守与无人值守机器人库，可自动登录、读取、录入与确认。每个机器人归属其所服务的业务团队而非 IT——由业务提出任务并验收结果。

en: A team nominates a task that is high volume and requires no judgement.
The bot is built and tested alongside the people who do the task today.
It runs on a schedule, or on demand from the user's desktop.
Anything the bot cannot handle is routed to a human exception queue.
The owning team sees every run in a log and can stop the bot themselves.
zh: 团队提出一项高频且无需人工判断的任务。
机器人与现有操作人员共同开发并测试。
按计划运行，或由用户在桌面端按需触发。
机器人无法处理的情形转入人工例外队列。
归属团队可查看每次运行日志，并可自行停止机器人。

en: screenshot — bot library with run status per team
screenshot — exception queue handed back to a human
zh: 截图 — 各团队机器人清单与运行状态
截图 — 转交人工处理的例外队列

en: Will a bot take my job? || The tasks nominated so far are transcription tasks. Every bot in the library was proposed by the team that used to do the task by hand.
How do I get a bot for my task? || Submit it through the intake form. If it is high volume and rule-based, it usually reaches production in four to six weeks.
zh: 机器人会取代我的工作吗？ || 目前提出的任务均为数据搬运类工作。库中每个机器人都是由原本手工执行该任务的团队自己提出的。
我的任务如何申请机器人？ || 通过需求提交表单提出。若任务量大且规则明确，通常四到六周即可上线。

launched.zh: 自 2026 年 9 月起试点

tagline.en: One screen for every shipment in motion, from plant gate to customer dock.
tagline.zh: 一个屏幕看清所有在途货物，从工厂大门到客户月台。

problem.en: Shipment status lived in carrier portals, mailboxes and phone calls. Answering "where is it?" took three calls, and the answer was already out of date when it arrived.
problem.zh: 货物状态分散在承运商门户、邮箱与电话中。回答一句"货到哪了"要打三个电话，而答案到手时往往已经过时。

solution.en: A live map and exception list built on carrier and forwarder feeds. It does not show you every shipment equally — it raises the ones whose ETA no longer matches the promise.
solution.zh: 基于承运商与货代数据构建的实时地图与例外清单。它不会平铺所有货物，而是主动提示预计到达时间已偏离承诺的那些。

en: Tracking feeds are ingested from carriers and forwarders continuously.
Each movement is matched back to the order and the customer promise.
ETA is compared to promise; only deviations become exceptions.
Exceptions are assigned to a named owner with a countdown.
The resolution is recorded, so recurring lanes can be fixed at the root.
zh: 持续接入承运商与货代的跟踪数据。
每笔在途信息回溯匹配到订单与客户承诺。
将预计到达与承诺比对，仅偏差项生成例外。
例外项分派给指定责任人并附处理时限。
处理结果留档，便于对反复出问题的线路做根本改善。

en: screenshot — live map, exceptions ranked by risk
screenshot — single shipment timeline with milestones
zh: 截图 — 实时地图，例外按风险排序
截图 — 单票货物里程碑时间线

en: Which lanes are in the pilot? || Apodaca outbound to US customers, September to December 2026. Monterrey and Hangzhou follow once the feed quality is proven.
Can I join the pilot from another plant? || Yes, if your main carriers already provide a tracking feed. Use the join button and the owner will confirm feasibility in a week.
zh: 试点覆盖哪些线路？ || Apodaca 出口至美国客户，2026 年 9 月至 12 月。数据质量验证后再推广至 Monterrey 与杭州。
其他工厂可以加入试点吗？ || 可以，前提是你的主要承运商已提供跟踪数据。点击加入按钮，负责人将在一周内确认可行性。

tagline.en: Every freight invoice checked against the contracted rate before it reaches Finance.
tagline.zh: 每张运费发票在进入财务前自动与合同费率比对。

problem.en: Freight invoices were approved largely on trust because checking them by hand was not affordable at that volume. Discrepancies were found months later during audit, if at all.
problem.zh: 受制于人力，运费发票基本靠信任放行。差异往往数月后审计时才被发现，甚至根本不被发现。

solution.en: An automated three-way match between the invoice, the shipment record and the contracted rate card. Clean invoices are approved automatically; mismatches arrive at Finance with the evidence already attached.
solution.zh: 在发票、运输记录与合同费率之间自动三方比对。无差异发票自动放行；有差异的则连同证据一并推送给财务。

en: The invoice is received and parsed, whatever format the carrier sends.
Each line is matched to the shipment record it claims to bill.
Charges are compared against the contracted rate card and accessorial rules.
Clean invoices route straight to payment approval.
Mismatches are queued with a dispute pack the carrier can be sent as-is.
zh: 接收并解析发票，兼容承运商各种格式。
逐行匹配到其所对应的运输记录。
费用与合同费率及附加费规则比对。
无差异发票直接进入付款审批。
差异项生成可直接发送承运商的争议材料并排队处理。

en: screenshot — match result with the disputed line highlighted
screenshot — dispute pack generated for the carrier
zh: 截图 — 比对结果，差异行高亮
截图 — 自动生成的承运商争议材料

en: What happens if the rate card is out of date? || Every invoice is matched against the rate card version that was valid on the shipment date, not the one loaded today.
Does Finance still approve payment? || Yes. The tool removes the checking, not the approval. Finance sees a clean queue and a dispute queue.
zh: 如果费率表未更新会怎样？ || 每张发票按发运日期当时生效的费率版本比对，而非当前版本。
财务还需要审批付款吗？ || 需要。工具替代的是核对而非审批。财务看到的是"无差异"与"待争议"两个队列。

tagline.en: Automated release approvals for import and export documents — no more chasing signatures.
tagline.zh: 进出口单据自动放行审批——不再四处追签字。

problem.en: Every shipment's document approval was chased by email across trade compliance, quality and finance. One missing sign-off held a loaded truck at the gate, and nobody could see whose desk it was sitting on.
problem.zh: 每票货的单据审批都要在关务合规、质量与财务之间邮件催办。一个签字缺失就能让满载的卡车停在门口，而没人知道单子卡在谁手上。

solution.en: A rules engine that grants routine approvals automatically and escalates only the exceptions, keeping a full audit trail that customs can be shown directly.
solution.zh: 规则引擎自动放行常规单据，仅将例外升级处理，同时保留可直接向海关出示的完整审计轨迹。

en: The document is submitted once, by whoever prepares it.
Rules are checked: HS code, licence validity, value threshold, partner status.
Routine cases are released automatically, in seconds.
Exceptions route to the named approver for that rule, with a deadline.
The full trail is stored for customs audit and internal control.
zh: 由单据制作人一次性提交。
系统校验规则：HS 编码、许可有效性、金额阈值、合作方状态。
常规情形数秒内自动放行。
例外情形按规则分派给指定审批人，并设定时限。
完整轨迹留存，供海关审计与内控使用。

systems.zh: ERP、关务合规系统、单据归档

en: wireframe — approval rules matrix, in design review
wireframe — exception queue with SLA countdown
zh: 线框图 — 审批规则矩阵，设计评审中
线框图 — 例外队列与时限倒计时

en: Is an automatic approval legally acceptable? || The rules were written with trade compliance and are evidenced in the audit trail. Anything outside the agreed rules still needs a person.
When can Apodaca use it? || Monterrey pilots first in Q1 2027. Apodaca follows once the Mexican rule set is validated in production.
zh: 自动审批在法律上可以接受吗？ || 规则由关务合规团队共同制定，并在审计轨迹中留证。超出既定规则的情形仍需人工审批。
Apodaca 什么时候可以使用？ || Monterrey 于 2027 年第一季度先行试点。墨西哥规则集在生产环境验证后再推广至 Apodaca。

tagline.en: Give every inbound truck a slot, so the dock stops being a queue.
tagline.zh: 为每辆到货车辆分配时段，让月台不再排队。

problem.en: Inbound trucks arrive unannounced. Docks swing between idle and gridlocked within the same shift, receiving overtime is impossible to forecast, and suppliers are told to "come in the morning".
problem.zh: 到货车辆不预约就来。同一个班次内月台时而空闲、时而堵死，收货加班无法预测，而给供应商的答复只是"上午来"。

solution.en: Supplier-facing slot booking tied to the receiving plan, so the dock knows what is arriving and when, and a late supplier is visible before the truck is at the gate.
solution.zh: 面向供应商的时段预约，与收货计划联动。月台提前知道什么货何时到，供应商延误在车到门口之前就能被看到。

en: Currently in discovery — the flow below is the working hypothesis.
Suppliers book an unloading slot against published dock capacity.
The receiving plan is generated from confirmed bookings.
Arrivals are checked in against the slot they booked.
Deviations are measured per supplier and fed back to purchasing.
zh: 当前处于需求调研阶段——以下流程为工作假设。
供应商按公布的月台运力预约卸货时段。
基于已确认的预约生成收货计划。
到货按其预约时段签到。
按供应商统计偏差并反馈给采购。

en: wireframe — supplier slot booking calendar
wireframe — dock capacity model per shift
zh: 线框图 — 供应商时段预约日历
线框图 — 按班次的月台运力模型

en: Can I influence the scope? || Yes — discovery is open until December 2026. Contact the owner or submit your dock's specific constraints through the intake form.
Why is this not being built yet? || Two plants describe the problem differently. Discovery exists to find out whether one solution serves both before anything is committed.
zh: 我可以参与界定范围吗？ || 可以——需求调研开放至 2026 年 12 月。请联系负责人，或通过需求表单提交你月台的具体约束。
为什么还没开始开发？ || 两个工厂对问题的描述不同。调研的目的就是在投入之前确认一个方案能否同时适用。

scope.en: Replaced three plant-level spreadsheet processes with one planning workspace and one published plan.
scope.zh: 以统一计划工作台与唯一发布版本，替代三个工厂各自的表格流程。

outcome.en: One plan of record across three sites. Baseline measurement of planning cycle time starts Q4 2026.
outcome.zh: 三个基地共用唯一计划版本。计划周期时间基线测量自 2026 年第四季度开始。

scope.zh: 建立机器人库并由业务团队自主管理；完成十九项数据搬运任务自动化。

outcome.en: Tasks moved from individual desks to a managed library with run logs and a human exception queue.
outcome.zh: 任务从个人电脑转入可管理的机器人库，具备运行日志与人工例外队列。

scope.en: Three-way match between invoice, shipment and contracted rate card, with generated dispute packs.
scope.zh: 实现发票、运输记录与合同费率三方比对，并自动生成争议材料。

outcome.en: Every invoice now checked before Finance approval instead of sampled at audit.
outcome.zh: 所有发票在财务审批前完成核对，替代以往审计抽检。

scope.en: Carrier and forwarder feeds ingested for Apodaca outbound lanes to US customers.
scope.zh: 接入承运商与货代数据，覆盖 Apodaca 至美国客户的出口线路。

outcome.en: Pilot running to December 2026; feed quality is the gate for further sites.
outcome.zh: 试点运行至 2026 年 12 月；数据质量是推广至其他基地的前置条件。

note.en: Live at three sites, Monterrey in pilot.
